title: Running time and output of suffix extraction
statement: For all Boolean words $u$ and $v$, the suffix-extraction machine, started on the pair encoding of $u$ and $v$, halts after exactly $3(|\langle u,v\rangle|+1)$ steps with output equal to the word obtained from $v$ by deleting its first $|u|$ bits.
replaced:
For all binary words $u$ and $v$, the suffix extractor run on
the pair encoding $\mathrm{pair}(u,v)$ (every bit of $u$ doubled, then the separator $01$, then $v$) halts within $3(\ell + 1)$ steps, where $\ell$ is the length of
that paired input, and its output is the suffix of $v$ obtained by dropping its
first $|u|$ bits.
